_comment: Canned LLM replies for --mock mode, keyed by stage. Lets the full agent run with no API key.

plan.interpretation: Identify the three most significant solid-state battery news items published in the last 7 days, with sources.
assumptions: 'Last week' means the 7 days up to and including today.
'Developments' means product, research, manufacturing or funding news, not opinion pieces.
Significance is judged by how concrete the news is (production, results, money) and how many sources report it.

steps.description: Search general solid-state battery news from the last week
steps.rationale: Broad query to see what is being reported.
A second wording catches items the first query missed.

steps.description: Compute what share of collected results fall inside the 7-day window
steps.rationale: Quantifies how much of the evidence is actually recent.

steps.description: Rank in-window items and pick the top 3 developments
steps.rationale: Turns raw results into the three findings the goal asks for.
The goal needs a saved structured report.

findings.title: Automaker starts pilot production of solid-state cells
findings.summary: A pilot line is now producing solid-state cells for test vehicles, with volume production targeted later in the decade.

findings.title: Sulfide electrolyte survives 1,000 cycles without dendrites
findings.summary: A university team reports a sulfide solid electrolyte that ran 1,000 charge cycles in lab cells without dendrite short circuits.
findings.why_selected: Addresses a key technical barrier, with a measured result.

findings.title: Startup raises funding to scale solid-state manufacturing
findings.summary: A solid-state battery startup closed a funding round to build a larger factory.

reason.notes: R4 is analysis rather than news; R5 falls outside the 7-day window and was excluded.

replan.interpretation: Same goal, new approach after every search failed.
assumptions: The earlier queries failed for technical reasons, so one simpler query is tried.

steps.description: Retry with one simple, broad query
steps.rationale: Earlier searches all failed; a single broad query is the cheapest new attempt.

steps.description: Pick the top 3 developments from whatever was found
